consequence.statement: The controller exposes two additional certificate timestamp metrics (certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds); the evidence states no failure, rejection, ignored setting, lost permission, or required migration, so an operator need do nothing.
